items.summary: Containment remains the correct operating disposition. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, analytics is unavailable fleet-wide, 56 improvements are measuring, 21 requests failed, and 7 repairs remain open. Reject the three new site-factory admissions and all new prototypes or telemetry requests. Preserve existing work only. After CTO completes or closes the saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case with root cause, isolated validation, rollback, and release-boundary evidence, execute the already-queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement.

Retain the allthingsmasonic.com affiliate CTA refinement as the next revenue experiment after capacity release. Evidence: 61 Amazon clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission for the 2026-09-21 window. Hypothesis: clearer commercial-card hierarchy, CTA labels, disclosure adjacency, focus states, contrast, and mobile spacing will improve qualified affiliate engagement without changing destinations, tracking, dependencies, or data collection. Smallest reversible prototype: one existing commercial-card treatment. Metric: affiliate clicks, ordered items, and site-attributed commission; time-to-learn: 14 days or the established measurement threshold. License/security risk: none from the UI change; retain existing dependency and disclosure boundaries. Rollback: revert the isolated card treatment.

Retain the americastrikes.com affiliate-reference repair within existing ownership; do not create duplicate work. Evidence: the retained task set identifies stale or broken affiliate references and a required redirect-to-registry synchronization check; the 2026-09-21 site row records 129 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Fleet use case: preserve monetization-path integrity and attribution correctness before any conversion claim. Metric: all affected destinations resolve correctly and use the registered tracking ID; revenue lift remains unknown. Time-to-learn: immediate validation for technical integrity, then the existing measurement window. Smallest reversible prototype: repair only the enumerated references and validate final URLs, tracking IDs, links, build, and redirects. Rollback: revert only those references and synchronization changes.

Retain a deferred fleet product opportunity for AI-cost guardrails, without admitting implementation this cycle. Evidence: AI usage is $997.46 across 5,514 calls for the September window, including materially higher-cost sites, while revenue attribution is incomplete and analytics is unavailable. Fleet use case: prevent content or automation spend from outrunning measurable commercial output. Metric: AI cost per eligible published or verified outcome, blocked-call rate, and attributable commission where available; do not invent a revenue baseline. Time-to-learn: one reporting cycle after an owner-approved prototype. Smallest reversible prototype: read-only threshold report for one site and one workflow, with no credential, schedule, dependency, or production changes. Risks: false savings from suppressing useful work, incomplete attribution, and provider/API licensing or model-policy changes. Rollback: disable the report rule without affecting execution.
